name: Meeting-Free Creation Days
title: Keep two creation days meeting-free each week.
benefit: Two full days of real progress each week.
subtitle: Calendar Structure
rationale: Removing meetings from entire days goes beyond managing fragmentation and eliminates it.

evidence.summary: Reducing meeting load and interruptions preserves energy and lowers the cost of resuming complex work.

indications: Meetings are already clustered but still touch every day.
Deep work needs full days, not fragments.
Calendar control is sufficient to protect whole days.
